notes.title: Customer Health Dashboard Design
notes.content:
Customer Health Dashboard — Design & Metrics
Last updated: 2026-03-01

Overview:
Track customer health across 5 dimensions, scored 1-100, color-coded:
- Green (80-100): Healthy, likely to renew/expand
- Yellow (50-79): At risk, needs attention
- Red (0-49): Critical, churn imminent

Dimensions:
1. Product Usage (40% weight): DAU/MAU ratio, feature breadth, time in app
2. Support Health (20% weight): Ticket volume (lower=better), response satisfaction
3. Engagement (15% weight): Meeting attendance, email opens, community participation
4. Expansion Signals (15% weight): User growth, feature requests, budget discussions
5. Relationship (10% weight): NPS score, champion engagement, exec sponsorship

- Green: 38 (81%)
- Yellow: 6 (13%)
- Red: 3 (6%)

notes.title: QBR Template
notes.content:
Quarterly Business Review Template — Customer-Facing

Slide 1: Executive Summary
- Account health score + trend
- Key metrics: DAU, features used, time saved
- Top achievements this quarter

Slide 2: Usage Analytics
- Active users vs licensed seats
- Feature adoption breakdown
- Usage trends (daily, weekly, monthly)
- Comparison to similar companies (anonymized)

Slide 3: Value Delivered
- Hours saved per user per week (from analytics)
- ROI calculation: time × hourly rate × users
- Customer quotes from their team
- Year-over-year improvement

Slide 4: Support & Satisfaction
- Tickets submitted and resolved
- Average resolution time
- NPS score (if available)
- Feature requests submitted

Slide 5: Product Roadmap
- What shipped since last QBR
- What's coming next quarter
- Customer-requested features in pipeline

Slide 6: Action Items & Next Steps
- Recommended actions (expand seats, enable new features)
- Training opportunities
- Renewal discussion (if applicable)
- Success plan for next quarter

Cadence: Quarterly for enterprise ($50K+), semi-annual for team tier

notes.title: Customer Onboarding Playbook
notes.content:
Customer Onboarding Playbook — v2.0
Last updated: 2026-02-15

Onboarding Timeline (Enterprise — 2 weeks):

Day 1: Kickoff Call
- Welcome + introductions
- Success criteria definition
- Technical requirements review
- Schedule training sessions
- Share onboarding timeline

Day 2-3: Technical Setup
- SSO configuration (if enterprise)
- Tool connections (prioritize most-used tools)
- Data initial sync
- Admin training for IT team

Day 4-5: User Training — Wave 1
- Train champion + 5-10 power users
- Cover: search, context panel, integrations
- Provide quick-start guide and video library

Day 6-10: User Training — Wave 2
- Train remaining users (can be self-serve with guide)
- Drop-in Q&A sessions
- Monitor activation metrics

Day 11-14: Optimization
- Review usage data
- Address low-adoption users individually
- Fine-tune AI relevance based on feedback
- Schedule 30-day check-in

Success Criteria (default, customize per customer):
- 60% of licensed users active within 14 days
- 3+ tools connected per user
- Positive qualitative feedback from champion

Team tier onboarding is lighter:
- Self-serve with email drip sequence
- Optional 30-min kickoff call
- In-app guided tour
- 7-day check-in email (automated)

notes.title: Customer FAQ Document
notes.content:
Customer FAQ — For Onboarding and Support

## Getting Started

Q: How long does setup take?
A: Individual: 5 minutes. Team: 15-30 minutes (admin setup + tool connections). Enterprise: 1-2 weeks (includes SSO, training, data migration).

Q: Which tools can I connect?
A: Currently: Slack, Notion, GitHub, Google Calendar, Jira. More coming in Q2-Q3 2026.

Q: Is my data safe?
A: Yes. SOC2 Type I certified. Free tier: on-device processing. Enterprise: encryption at rest, SSO, admin controls, audit logs.

## Usage

Q: Why isn't the context panel showing relevant results?
A: It learns from your usage patterns. Give it 2-3 days of regular use. You can also manually mark results as helpful/not helpful to improve relevance.

Q: Search is slow — what can I do?
A: Check: (1) number of connected tools, (2) workspace size. For large Notion workspaces (5K+ pages), initial sync takes longer. Contact support if consistently >3 seconds.

Q: Can I use TechFlow offline?
A: Partial — search history and recent items are cached locally. New searches require internet.

## Billing

Q: How do I add more seats?
A: Settings → Team → Invite members. Billing adjusts automatically (prorated).

Q: Can I downgrade from Enterprise to Pro?
A: At renewal only. Contact your CSM (omar@techflow.ai) to discuss.

## Support

Q: How do I get help?
A: In-app chat (bottom-right), email support@techflow.ai, or Slack connect for enterprise customers.

Q: What are your support hours?
A: 9am-6pm PT Monday-Friday. Enterprise: 24/7 for P0 issues.

notes.title: Customer Success Automation Ideas
notes.content:
Customer Success Automation — Ideas for Scale

Problem: I'm the only CSM. As we grow to 100+ accounts, I can't manually manage all of them.

Proposed automation (by priority):

1. Health Score Alerts (HIGH)
- Auto-email me when any account drops below 60/100
- Include: reason for drop, suggested action
- Implementation: webhook from analytics dashboard

2. Usage-Based Drip Emails (HIGH)
- If user hasn't logged in for 7 days → 'We miss you' email with tips
- If user connects new tool → 'Here's how to get more from [tool]' email
- If team hits 80% seat utilization → expansion nudge to admin
- Implementation: Intercom + custom events

3. Renewal Automation (MEDIUM)
- 90 days before renewal: auto-generate QBR report
- 60 days: send renewal proposal with recommended tier
- 30 days: reminder to CSM to have conversation

4. Onboarding Sequences (MEDIUM)
- Automated email drip for self-serve customers (7 emails over 14 days)
- In-app checklist (connect tools, first search, invite team)
- Automated NPS survey at day 30

5. Support Escalation (LOW)
- Auto-assign tickets based on account tier (enterprise = priority)
- Alert me if any account submits 3+ tickets in a week
- CSAT survey after every resolved ticket

Tools needed:
- Intercom (or Zendesk) — $100-200/month
- Customer.io (or equivalent) — $150/month
- Build custom health dashboard (engineering time)
